# Convert PNG to PDF

- Route: `/tools/convert-png-to-pdf`
- Kind: `tool`
- Category: `image`
- Slug: `convert-png-to-pdf`

## Summary

Turn PNG screenshots, graphics, and scans into clean, crisp PDF documents. (Image tools)

## Details

PNG is the format for screenshots, diagrams, and graphics with crisp text and sharp edges. When you need to send or print one as a document, a PDF is the right wrapper. Media Manipulator embeds your PNG losslessly into a PDF so every edge stays sharp.
### What it does
- Wraps a PNG image into a single-page PDF document.
- Embeds the image losslessly so text and line art stay crisp.
- Flattens transparency onto white, since PDF pages are opaque.
- Produces a standard PDF that opens and prints anywhere.
### How to use it
1. Upload PNG: Drop in a .png screenshot, diagram, or graphic.
2. We embed it: The PNG is composited onto a white page and embedded losslessly.
3. Generate PDF: A standard single-page PDF is assembled.
4. Download PDF: Save a crisp .pdf ready to share or print.
### Supported formats
- Input: png
- Output: pdf
- The PNG is embedded losslessly. Transparency is flattened onto white because PDF pages are opaque.
### Technical details
- PNGs are decoded and embedded with lossless zlib (Flate) compression, so sharp text and edges are preserved exactly — no JPEG artifacts.
- Transparent areas become white because PDF pages do not have an alpha channel.
- The page is sized from the image at 96 DPI for a sensible default physical size.
### Use cases
- Bug reports: Turn a screenshot into a PDF to attach to a ticket.
- Diagrams and charts: Wrap an exported graphic into a shareable PDF.
- Scanned forms: Convert a PNG scan into a tidy PDF document.
- Printing: Get crisp, predictable prints from a PNG.
### FAQ
Q: How do I convert a PNG to PDF for free?
A: Upload your .png above and click convert — the output is a single-page PDF. It is free and requires no signup.
Q: Does PNG to PDF keep text sharp?
A: Yes. The PNG is embedded losslessly, so sharp text and line art stay crisp with no JPEG-style artifacts.
Q: What happens to a transparent PNG?
A: Transparent areas are flattened onto a white background because PDF pages are opaque. The visible content is unchanged.
Q: Can I merge several PNGs into one PDF?
A: This tool creates one PDF per image. Convert each PNG and merge the PDFs in a merge tool for multi-page documents.
